description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for the 'git apply --reverse' command, demonstrating various scenarios of applying patches in reverse within a Git repository. The script sets up repositories, creates and modifies files, and verifies the behavior of reverse patch application.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label, runs setup commands and verifies expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that specified output is empty.
